rows.summary: LITE's operating leverage is accelerating dramatically: operating income surged from -$8.4M (Q4'25) to +$174.5M (Q3'26) on revenue growth from $481M to $808M. Gross margins expanded to 44.2% from 33.3% a year ago, confirming the business model has reached critical scale with high incremental margins.
rows.what_changed: The previous inflection point (breakeven to profitability) has now become a powerful operating leverage story where each incremental dollar of revenue drops disproportionately to the bottom line.
rows.why_now: Q3'26 results showed operating income nearly tripling QoQ from $64.3M to $174.5M, far exceeding the revenue growth rate of 21% QoQ — proving the operating leverage thesis is accelerating, not just inflecting.

rows.subtype_label: Massive EPS Miss After Streak Raises Questions
rows.summary: SMAR posted a -115% EPS surprise ($-0.05 actual vs $0.33 estimate) in Q4 FY2025, breaking a streak of 5 consecutive beats. The magnitude is extreme — from beating by $0.10-$0.14/quarter to missing by $0.38. This suggests either a major cost overrun, heavy reinvestment spending, or a one-time charge that broke the profitability trajectory. The operating income was -$3.4M in Q3 FY2025 (near breakeven), so the Q4 miss implies a sharp reversal. Investors need to understand whether this is a one-time reset or a structural shift.
rows.what_changed: SMAR went from consistently beating by double-digit percentages to a massive miss, breaking the reliability narrative.
rows.why_now: The Q4 FY2025 earnings release (March 2025) showed the dramatic miss after a long beat streak.
